mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned large-scale open-pit gold development project, 25km south-west of Coolgardie in Western Australia's Eastern Goldfields (~65km west of Kalgoorlie), on granted mining leases. Pre-Feasibility Study completed 8 July 2026: production target ~150,000 oz Au per annum from a 5 Mtpa processing plant (Stage 1, designed for expansion to 7.5 Mtpa), 19-year operating life, first production H2 CY2028 (Q4 CY2028). PFS economics (post-AR, mid-2026 AUD, real unless noted): post-tax NPV5 A$2.3B at FID (targeted 1 April 2027), IRR 43%, 2-year payback from first production; C1 cash cost A$2,130/oz, AISC A$2,520/oz; avg annual free cash flow A$330M, EBITDA A$510M (nominal). Capex: pre-FID A$180M, post-FID A$560M, pre-production operations A$115M, sustaining A$99M LOM. LOM: ~125 kozpa avg (2.3 Moz total incl. stockpile processing in final years), throughput grade 1.0 g/t Au, 92% recovery (Ore Reserve basis 0.86 g/t, 90%); strip ratio 4.9:1, mining rate ~40 Mtpa. Gold price assumption US$3,800/oz (~A$5,500/oz), USD:AUD 0.69, 5% discount. Production target ~97% Probable Ore Reserves, 3% Inferred. Maiden Ore Reserve 90 Mt @ 0.86 g/t Au for 2.5 Moz (100% Probable, reported 8 July 2026, based on Dec 2025 MRE). Early construction activities underway; DFS commenced May 2026; updated Ore Reserve (from July 2026 MRE) planned. Strategic funding with Franco-Nevada: initial $220M (Feb 2026) plus additional $200M agreed (14 Sep 2026); $250M placement announced 16 Sep 2026. No production; AISC/C1 are PFS projections in AUD (no USD conversion applied).
mines.processing: Planned 5 Mtpa conventional open-pit mining and CIL processing plant (expandable to 7.5 Mtpa)
mines.status: Development (PFS completed July 2026; early works underway; FID targeted April 2027)

notes: FY2025 annual report (year ended 30 June 2025, published 25 September 2025). FY2026 annual report not yet published as of 25 Sep 2026 (marketindex forecast 24 Sep 2026). Minerals 260 is a developer with no gold production: acquired the Bullabulling Gold Project from Norton Gold Fields in April 2025 for $166.5M (A$156.5M cash + 83,333,333 shares at A$0.12 = A$10M), funded by a A$220M equity raising at A$0.12/share (1,833,333,333 shares; re-listed 10 Apr 2025). FY2025: cash and cash equivalents A$54.38M at 30 June 2025 (A$27.38M bank + A$27.0M term deposits); total comprehensive loss A$11.52M. Aston Lithium Project sold to Delta Lithium during the year for $450,000 cash; Moora copper-gold-nickel-PGE project 100%-owned (exploration stage, not included as a mine). Post-AR updates: Dec 2025 MRE 130 Mt @ 1.0 g/t Au = 4.5 Moz (Indicated 93 Mt @ 1.0 = 3.0 Moz; Inferred 42 Mt @ 1.1 = 1.5 Moz; cut-off 0.4 g/t in A$4,500/oz pit shell); July 2026 MRE 190 Mt @ 1.0 g/t Au = 6.2 Moz (Indicated 140 Mt @ 0.98 = 4.4 Moz; Inferred 51 Mt @ 1.0 = 1.7 Moz; cut-off 0.35 g/t in A$5,250/oz pit shell; effective 8 July 2026); maiden Ore Reserve 90 Mt @ 0.86 g/t = 2.5 Moz Probable as at 8 July 2026. Managing Director Luke McFadyen; Non-Executive Chair Timothy Goyder; Adam Smits appointed Non-Executive Director Feb 2026. All dollar figures in AUD unless stated.
